description: Probabilistic quantizer holding twelve scales, each with a weight per note, choosing a neighbouring note by weight rather than always the nearest one

params.text: Shifts the root note of the mother scale, -11 to 11 semitones
Picks which of the twelve stored mother scales is in use
Rotates the scale by that many positions, -11 to 11, so the notes and weights start at another degree of it; 0 uses the mother scale itself
Sets how far either side of the incoming note the choice may reach, 0 to 6 semitones; at 0 the module quantizes to the nearest note of the scale with no choice
Shapes how the chance of a note falls away with distance from the incoming note: turned down only the closest notes come up, turned up notes out at the edge of SPAN come up nearly as often
Sets the probability weight of that note, 0% to 100%; 50% takes the weight from the same position of the mother scale, and 100% takes that note outright with no further choice
Nothing changes when this button is clicked: the first note of a mother scale is always in the scale
Switches that note in or out of the scale; the buttons are locked while CHILD is not 0

inputs.text: While a cable is here the module quantizes only when a trigger arrives, rather than on every change of the input pitch
Adds semitones to the root of the mother scale, quantized, so a C adds nothing and a D raises the root two semitones
Adds semitones to the scale number, quantized, so a C selects the scale the knob points at and a D the one two on from it
Adds semitones to the rotation, quantized, so a C leaves the rotation at the knob setting
A seed for the internal random generator, which is reset to this value every process cycle, so a fresh seed per trigger is wanted for fresh choices

outputs.text: The chosen note as a pitch
A gate each time the output pitch changes
The weight of the note that was chosen; the POW Output Config menu switches it to put out the notes of the scale instead

notes: the note buttons can be edited only while CHLD is 0; at any other setting of CHLD they are locked
the internal random generator is set back to the RND seed on every process cycle, so a fresh voltage at RND is needed for each trigger if the choices are to differ
where the notes switched on make one of the named scales, that name is shown in the header
menu: Scales — a submenu of forty-two named scales, from Major and Dorian through to Wholetone; choosing one sets the note buttons to that scale
Copy Scale — takes a copy of the whole selected mother scale, its notes and all its weights
Paste Scale — writes the copied mother scale into the scale now selected, in this module or another one
Copy Child — takes a copy of the weights of the child scale now selected
Paste Child — writes the copied child weights into the child scale now selected
Disable Visualization — stops the note display being drawn
Disable DNA — stops a child weight of 50% from taking the weight at the same position of the mother scale
Disable Grab — stops a weight of 100% from taking that note outright
Root Based Display — names the notes by their distance from the root of the scale
C Based Display — names the notes from C
Child CV Mode — reads the CHLD voltage as Root Based or as In Scale
Mode — what POW carries: Power, Scale Gates, Scale Pitches or PES
Scale Base — whether the scale POW puts out starts on the Root or on the Child
Scale Step — builds the POW scale from every note of it, every second note and so on up to every seventh, so 3 gives a stack of thirds
Pack Scale — keeps the pitches POW puts out inside one octave instead of climbing an octave where the scale wraps round
Preserve Octaves — builds the POW pitches on the octave of the child rather than on the octave of the root
Auto Channels — a floor of 1 to 16 on the number of output channels while TRG is patched; the count otherwise follows the larger of the CV and TRG channel counts
